records.title: Constitution of the Bhoomi Federation
records.authority_note: New fictional canon, created in 2026; not a document or event from 2025. It has no real-world legal effect and is not evidence of statehood or recognition. No real-world institution or service is represented as operating.
records.summary: Establishes the fictional rights floor, civic-federal structure, elected Assembly, executive accountability, courts, emergency safeguards and amendment rules. It names the founder-specific, non-elective Chief Architect as Head of Country; the office becomes permanently vacant after the founder's tenure, with no successor. The Assembly then supervises collectively without becoming Head of Country.
